title: metadata: a stored object_extension conversion notice reads data.name, which an extension body does not carry, so every extension warns as "<unnamed>" and one warning per conversion covers them all
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbahe4v7GBD94QeSnir

Filing gate: ② a should-fix of the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record on PR #29589 (#29554, head `91fbde28`, record 6587797860, verdict PASS), outside that PR's file surface. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What happens

Once PR #29589 lands, the stored pass wraps an `object_extension` row as `objectExtensions: [row]`, so ADR-0087 conversions that walk `objectExtensions[]` replay over stored extension rows at the rehydration seams. The notice those seams print is deduped once per process by a key built from the item's name:

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-item-conversion.ts` `convertStoredItem` (~L60-69 on `main`): `name = data.name`; key `conversionId|singular|name`; message `stored ${singular}/${name ?? '<unnamed>'}`.
- `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts` (~L881-889): the same shape, reading `row.name` (the stored row's column, which may already carry the extension's identity; measure).

An extension body carries `extend`, not `name`, so at the protocol seam every extension row warns as `object_extension/<unnamed>`, and the key `conversionId|object_extension|` collapses all extension rows to ONE warning per conversion: an operator with three stale extensions hears about one, unnamed. Rows still convert correctly; only the operator's notice is wrong. `listSlotNameOf` already reads `extend` for this type.

## Done when

- Measure what `row.name` holds for a stored `object_extension` row at the database-loader seam, and what `data.name` holds at the protocol seam.
- Each seam names the item by the identity the type actually uses (for an extension, its `extend` target, or `listSlotNameOf`), so the notice names the row and the dedupe key separates rows. A test with two stale extension rows asserts two notices, each naming its target.
- ⛔ `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is under a server-seat freeze until 06:00 UTC on 3 November; this card's files are its siblings, not that file.

Serial: after PR #29589 (without it no conversion reaches a stored extension row).

Related: #29554 / PR #29589, #29366 / PR #29513.
